P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between front-ECU connector A-
09X and ETACS-ECU connector C-111 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 10.
NO : Repair them. Confirm the DTC 13 is not displayed.
STEP 10. Replacement of ECU.
(1) Replace the front-ECU.
(2) Confirm the DTC 13 is not displayed.
Q: Does DTC 13 set?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. Confirm the DTC 13 is not 
displayed.
NO : There is no action to taken.
